emma: quick heads-up — had a call with Arbor Labs. they want to let HW partners redistribute a quantized derivative of their open 13B model through cloud & appliance marketplaces.
raj: noted. primary legal asks?
emma: redistribution allowed but with attribution, no resale of unmodified weights, and export-control carveouts for certain regions. they also want a signed provenance token when a partner bundles weights + runtime.
lucas: runtime + token = ops work. we need to confirm whether marketplace SKUs can attach a signed attestation. many marketplaces only support a simple artifact URL.
sophie: timeline for announcement? arbor wants a joint marketplace listing + co-announcement in 6 weeks if legal and infra ok.
matt: sales + GTM: we should standardize the SKU offering: 1) hosted API routing to Arbor-verified model; 2) downloadable quantized weight bundle for onprem/hw partners (with EULA acceptance); 3) hybrid appliance image for SI integrators.
raj: draft legal constraints I want in the distro addendum:

```
- Redistribution: Permitted for enumerated HW partners only; no further sublicensing.
- Attribution: Arbor Labs and Redwood Inference must be credited on product and marketplace listing.
- Export Controls: Customer must comply with export laws; vendor must implement geoblocking for embargoed jurisdictions.
- Provenance: Partner must provide signed attestation (JWT) per release; keys managed by Arbor or Redwood-KMS.
- Security: No plaintext weights distribution without AES-256 envelope + HSM-wrapped key.
```

emma: that looks good. can we avoid mandating HSM for all partners? some edge HW partners won't have HSM.
raj: ok — change to "HSM recommended; KMS acceptable with documented access controls".
lucas: implementation notes: marketplace flow needs to support attaching metadata (attestation JWT) and a download guard that enforces per-customer license acceptance. for appliance images we can bake in a verification step that checks the JWT before enabling model serving.
sophie: product question — do we need two SKUs (hosted vs onprem) or one SKU with deployment options?
matt: two SKUs is cleaner for revenue recognition and entitlements.
emma: action items:
- raj: produce distro addendum draft by EOD Tue (assign legal)
- lucas: prototype attestation + validation flow (marketplace metadata + appliance check) — sync Thu
- sophie/matt: finalize SKU mapping + co-announcement cadence — sync Fri
- ops-bot: create tracker ticket in partnerships/marketplace (#PL-4223)

ops-bot: created ticket PL-4223: "Arbor Labs quantized distribution + attestation flow" assigned to lucas, raj, sophie. https://tracker.internal/PL-4223 :white_check_mark:

emma: also flagged export control for AP/EMEA jurisdictions — raj pls loop compliance team.
raj: looping compliance. will add geoblock requirements and a short checklist for marketplace integrations.
lucas: one more technical ask — Arbor wants an optional delta-patch model variant (weights diff) to reduce bundle size. we should confirm licensing covers derivative diffs.
raj: include derivative diff language in addendum: allowed for distribution under same constraints; no reconstitution into a standalone commercial model.
emma: perfect. I'll prep a short partner FAQ and shared slide pack for announcement once legal + infra sign off. :+1:
